visual_elements.description: 3-D stacked 'multi-head' metaphor: five identical attention-layer rounded rectangles receding diagonally up-right. Front layer tagged 'h=1' (black oval, white text) is salmon; behind it h=2 lavender, h=3 yellow, h=4 light green, h=5 peach. Each visible top edge carries a gray 'Similarity' pill (left) and gray 'Weighted SUM' pill (right); each right edge shows a green-dashed container of white boxes with red 'X' letters plus a column of blue 'W^U' boxes. Partially occluded inner boxes of back layers peek out at top: a green-dashed [X] box (topmost, h=5 output), a solid green box below-left of it, and a dark maroon box (likely an inner W^q) [?].

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Title: bold, ~26–30 px, two-color (red + dark navy) with a red subscript '2' on X. Diagram labels: ~9–13 px bold; pill texts ('Similarity', 'Weighted SUM', 'Probabilities') small bold dark-gray on light-gray pills. 'Scaling by √d' and 'Soft max' are rotated 90° (reading bottom-to-top) in maroon on pink boxes. 'h=1'–'h=5' are white bold on black ovals. 'K·q/√d' is rendered as a stacked vertical fraction. '*H* Heads' is blue italic with literal asterisks around H. Slide number '15' is bold red on yellow. Box letters 'X' are red serif-less capitals; W-labels are white on colored boxes with superscripts.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — all five head layers (h=1…h=5) are visible simultaneously, no mid-reveal bullets or builds. A live mouse cursor is visible near the upper 'Similarity' pills, indicating pointer movement during recording.
recreation_brief:
1. Canvas: white background (#FFFFFF), 16:9 widescreen.
2. Outer frame: rectangle with no fill, outline #C00000, 2.25 pt, inset ~6% from all slide edges.
3. Inner frame: rectangle with no fill, outline #0000CC, 1.5 pt, inset ~8% from all slide edges.
4. Slide-number badge: 0.9 cm oval, fill #FFFF99, outline #C00000 1.5 pt, centered at ~91% width / 14% height so it overlaps the red border at top-right; text '15', bold, #C00000, ~14 pt.
5. Front layer body: rounded rectangle, fill #F08080 (salmon), no outline, spanning ~12–66% width and ~30–80% height (center-left).
6. On the h=1 top edge (~30% height): gray pill (rounded rectangle, fill #D9D9D9, no outline) with bold dark-gray #333333 text 'Similarity', centered ~27% width.
7. Same-style gray pill 'Weighted SUM' (fill #D9D9D9, bold #333333 text), centered ~50% width on the h=1 top edge.
8. Black #000000 oval with white bold text 'h=1', centered ~63% width on the h=1 top edge.
9. Input ellipse: orange #F5A050 ellipse at ~12–19% width inside h=1, holding 4 stacked rows, each row = [white box with red 'X'] + [green #00B050 box with white text 'W^V'].
10. Key ellipse: green #6ABF6A ellipse immediately right of the input ellipse, holding 4 small green key boxes (presumed letter 'K' inside, too small to read [?]).
11. 'Dot Product' box: gray #D9D9D9 rectangle right of the key ellipse, bold dark-gray #333333 text 'Dot Product' (may wrap as 'Dot' / 'Product' on two lines).
12. Score matrix: 4 thin vertical connector lines between the 'Dot Product' box and the Scaling box, studded with small blue #0000CC dots.
13. 'K·q' label: small bold dark-gray label 'K·q' with a short arrow feeding into the Scaling box, placed just left of the Scaling box.
14. Scaling box: pink #DDA0DD vertical rounded rectangle; text 'Scaling by √d' rotated 90° (reading bottom-to-top), maroon #8B0000.
15. Fraction label: stacked vertical fraction 'K·q/√d' (numerator 'K·q', denominator '√d'), dark gray, placed between the Scaling and Soft max boxes.
16. Soft max box: pink #DDA0DD vertical rounded rectangle right of the Scaling box; text 'Soft max' rotated 90°, maroon #8B0000.
17. 'Probabilities' pill: gray #D9D9D9 pill directly above the Soft max box, bold dark-gray #333333 text 'Probabilities', with a small green #00B050 arrow connecting pill to box.
18. Σ box: white rectangle, outline #0000CC 1.5 pt, containing a large blue #0000CC 'Σ'; placed right of the Soft max box in h=1's upper flow row.
19. Multiply nodes: 4 red #CC0000 ⊗ nodes (circles with an X mark) cascading diagonally below the Σ box; label them V₁, V₂, V₃, V₄ (subscripts uncertain [?]) and give each a small beige #E8D8B0 hatched vector box.
20. W^U column: 4 blue #3333CC rectangles stacked vertically at h=1's right side, white text 'W^U' on each.
21. Output container: rounded rectangle with dashed #00B050 outline at h=1's right edge, containing 4 white boxes with red 'X' letters.
22. Connectors: thin red #CC0000 lines wiring Soft max → each ⊗ node, the ⊗ row → Σ, Σ → each W^U box, and the W^U boxes → the output X boxes.
23. Query row (bottom of h=1, ~19–41% width / 71–78% height): small label 'q₁' [?] with a tiny beige hatched box; below it a red #CC0000 box with white text 'W^q'; below that a rounded container with dashed #00B050 outline holding 4 white 'X' boxes, the 2nd filled #FF66CC with a dashed magenta outline (the attended word X₂); small red arrow from lower-left pointing up at the highlighted box.
24. Back layer h=2: duplicate the h=1 group, recolor the layer rectangle #C9A8D8, shift it ~4% width right and ~4% height up, send it behind h=1; keep only its 'Similarity' pill, 'Weighted SUM' pill, black oval 'h=2' (white text), and the right-edge green-dashed container of white 'X' boxes plus the column of blue #3333CC 'W^U' boxes; delete every other internal shape.
25. Back layer h=3: same operation, fill #EDE87F, oval 'h=3', offset ~8% width right / ~8% height up from h=1, one z-level deeper.
26. Back layer h=4: fill #C8E6B8, oval 'h=4', offset ~12% width right / ~12% height up from h=1, deeper still.
27. Back layer h=5: fill #F5CE9A, oval 'h=5', offset ~16% width right / ~16% height up from h=1, deepest z-level; the four back layers together occupy the band ~25–88% width / ~12–65% height.
28. Top peeking boxes: 3 small partially visible boxes at the very top of the stack — a green-dashed box with 'X' at ~63% width / ~13% height, a solid green box just below-left of it, and a dark maroon box at ~52% width / ~24% height (likely an inner W^q [?]).
29. Gray plane: freeform parallelogram spanning ~14–45% width / ~14–38% height over the stack's upper-left, fill #999999 at ~40% transparency, no outline; set its z-order in front of h=3–h=5 but behind h=2 and h=1, so it overlaps only the h=3–h=5 'Similarity' pills; optionally add a faint circular arc inside it [?].
30. Big arrow: thick curved block arrow, fill #CC0000, tail at ~60% width / ~82% height, sweeping clockwise up the right side, arrowhead at ~83% width / ~43% height pointing up toward h=5.
31. Arrow label: slightly rotated text '*H* Heads' (literal asterisks) along the arrow's upper stretch, #0000CC, bold italic ~12 pt.
32. W^(1)–W^(4) boxes: 4 small rectangles (~3% × 3.5% each), fill #CC0000, stacked vertically at ~63% width / 65–78% height beside the arrow's tail; white bold text 'W' with superscript '(1)', '(2)', '(3)', '(4)' (exact superscript formatting uncertain [?]).
33. Title: one bold line ~26–30 px, bottom-center at ~87% height (spanning ~34–69% width), inside the blue border: 'Multi Head' in #CC0000 + 'Self Attention of Word' in #1F3864 + 'X' in #CC0000 + '2' as a #CC0000 subscript.
34. Exclusions: no photographs anywhere; do not reproduce the mouse cursor (~31% width / ~28% height) or the black bar across the bottom ~5% of the frame — both are video-recording artifacts, not slide content.
